profile.ja: 格闘技系対魔忍。テンションが高く突っ込み満載の関西系の対魔忍。親の長期任務で関西に行くも数年が経つと、対魔忍の能力に目覚め、五車学園に転校する。クラスでもムードメーカーで、対魔忍の厳しい試練にも笑顔とノリで明るく元気にこなす。その姿は学園内でも有名であった。体を動かすことが得意で肌は日に焼けて褐色系。胸は貧乳で少しコンプレックスを感じている。先輩に当たるゆきかぜ以上に貧乳でちっぱい雫と裏で呼ばれている。胸の大きな人物を見ると負けたと、その場で崩れてしまいorz状態になる。
profile.en: (Ooshima Shizuku, she/her) She is a martial-arts-style Taimanin with a high-energy, joke-filled Kansai personality. After her parents were assigned to a long-term mission in Kansai, she eventually awakened her Taimanin abilities and transferred to Gosha Academy. In class she's the mood-maker, tackling the academy's harsh trials with a bright smile and lively spirit, a reputation that's spread throughout the school. She excels at physical activity, her skin tanned from the sun, and she has a modest bust that she feels a bit self-conscious about. Seniors call her "the tiny-chested Shizuku" behind her back, noting she's even flatter-chested than Mizuki Yukikaze. When she sees someone with a large chest, she collapses on the spot in an "orz" pose, feeling defeated.

text.ja: 「筋肉の事なら任せてくれてええよ。大島雫、関西弁やけど許してなぁ～」
text.en: If it's muscles you need, just leave it to me. This is Ooshima Shizuku—yeah, I'm speaking Kansai, so cut me some slack~

text.ja: 力関係なら、私に任せて。どんなもんでもぶっ壊すで～
text.en: When it comes to power dynamics, leave it to me. I'll smash anything.

text.ja: まだまだふうまには追い付かれへんけど、私だってやるんやから
text.en: I still can't keep up with Fuuma, but I'll give it my all.

text.ja: あの子もあの子も、なんでみんな胸が大きいねん。くそ～、負けた～！
text.en: Everyone's got huge chests—why is that? Damn, I'm defeated!

text.ja: 私のウチ来てぇーなふうま。一緒にあそぼうや！
text.en: Come over to my place, Fuuma. Let's play together!

text.ja: 走りなら誰にも負けへんで～。次は誰が私の相手するん？
text.en: If it's running, I won't lose to anyone. Who's next to take me on?

text.ja: 今日の訓練も元気にこなすでー！　私にかかれば厳しい訓練も楽しくなるんやから
text.en: I'll tackle today's training with energy! If I'm in charge, even tough drills become fun.

text.ja: 体を動かす事ってなんて素敵なんやろう。隣町まで競争やー
text.en: Moving your body is just wonderful. Race me to the next town!
